Accepted at all stations EXCEPT Sharps Creek. Units containing refrigerants only. Must be empty. Air conditioners,
dehumidifiers, freezers, heat pumps, refrigerators & water coolers. DO NOT cut cords or drain refrigerants. NO RV
refrigerators (except those containing cylopentane) accepted at any site. NO other appliances, or commercial units.

Maximum 10 tires, up to 20" rim diameter. NO heavy duty truck, tractor, or off-highway tires.
Call (541) 682-4120 for referral.

Wood Waste: Broken furniture, painted wood, particle board, pallets, wood with nails or screws. NO Formica, foam
core, or plastic coated, treated wood, non-wood laminates, mixed materials, railroad ties, hardware bigger than
your thumb. NO bags.
Yard Waste: Cut grass, brush, leaves, plants, trimmings, or limbs under 12" diameter. NO pet waste, to-go containers,
liquids, garbage. NO dirt/soil. NO bags.
